map.由体积流量与过流断面面积，按 v = Q/A 计算平均流速。: Compute mean velocity v = Q/A from volumetric flow and cross-sectional area, for pipes and channels, to check velocity against specification limits.
map.Q=A·v 的逆向运算，常用于管道与明渠设计校核。: The inverse of Q=A·v, often used for pipe and open-channel design checks.
map.已知流量与断面反推流速。: Back-calculate velocity from known flow and section.
map.D 0.1→0.15，A 增 2.25 倍，同流量 v 降到约 5.7 m/s。: D 0.1→0.15, A ×2.25, same flow v drops to about 5.7 m/s.
map.公式为断面平均流速，实际分布不均，设计用平均值校核。: Formula gives section mean velocity; actual distribution is uneven, design uses the mean.
map.v=Q/A 即连续性在不可压流的直接表达，变径必变 v。: v=Q/A is continuity for incompressible flow; changing diameter changes v.
